desc: Ideate and select the bottom-up canonical unordered-tree type DP with a virtual root for the top-level forest.

Implement the complete Python solution: parse S iteratively into an ordered forest, process nodes in reverse creation order to assign exact unordered-tree type IDs using sorted child type IDs, precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to the number of nodes, compute f[t] = fact[total_children] * prod invfact[count] * prod f[child]^count mod 998244353 for each type, then compute the final answer over the top-level root types with the same multinomial formula (virtual root) and print it.
Verify correctness on the samples and by the reachability/counting proof; edge cases and N=5000 performance are within constraints.
